第九章师言见闻暗存戒心（第1页）
日子在明修功法、暗练古卷的状态下缓缓度过。
韩东依旧悉心教导，除了吐纳法门，还时常给陈默讲述青阳城周边势力、修仙界基础常识、灵草辨识、法器符箓粗浅知识。
这日午后，师徒二人坐在院中小亭闲谈。
“修仙一途，族群各异，人族、妖类、乃至草木精怪，皆有追寻长生之辈。”韩东手执茶盏，缓缓说道，“只是天地法则偏爱人族，正统功法、传承法门，十之八九都只适合人族修炼。妖族想要修行，大多只能依靠血脉本能、上古传承，或是寻觅专门的妖修功法，想拿到人族顶尖典籍，难如登天。”
陈默闻言，心中微微一动，顺势问道：“师尊，难道就没有一种功法，是人族、妖类都能顺畅修习的吗？”
韩东略一思索，摇头道：“极少。世间现存的通用入门功法，最多只能让低阶妖兽勉强引气，运转起来损耗极大，进步缓慢。至于真正能让万族同修、毫无隔阂的功法，只存在于上古传闻之中，如今早已绝迹。那些典籍据说诞生于天地初开之时，包容万道，不分种族血脉，只是岁月流逝，早已淹没在历史尘埃里。”
说到此处，他看了陈默一眼，淡淡叮嘱：“你初入仙途，不必好高骛远。守好手中《青元引气诀》，稳步夯实炼气根基，才是正道。稀奇传闻听听便可，莫要心生贪念。”
“弟子谨记师尊教诲。”陈默躬身应道。
一番对话，让他心底的疑虑再次加重。
连见多识广、身为韩立后人的韩东，都直言万族同修的功法乃是上古绝迹之物。反观自己手中那卷兽皮古卷，不仅人族、狐类修习无碍，灵气运转顺滑，损耗微乎其微，修炼速度更是碾压当世入门典籍。
这卷古卷的来头，恐怕比他预想的还要恐怖。
他下意识瞥了一眼院内。小雪正在花圃边闲走，皮毛莹润，身形灵动，早已看不出当初体弱多病的模样。小家伙似乎察觉到他的目光，抬头望来，轻轻叫了一声。
这些时日一同修行，小雪的进步速度依旧****。同样的修行时长，它体内积蓄的能量，始终是陈默的两倍以上。照这个势头下去，用不了多久，这只原本平凡的野狐，恐怕会先一步突破境界。
“对了，你这只狐狸倒是乖巧。”韩东顺着他的目光看去，随口笑道，“寻常野狐沾染上灵气，要么躁动不安，要么野性大增，它却依旧温顺，倒是难得。”
“它自小跟着我，性子素来安静。”陈默不动声色地遮掩过去。
他不敢让师尊看出异常。一旦韩东发现小雪也在修炼，且进度异常迅猛，必定会追查缘由，那卷兽皮古卷的秘密便再也藏不住了。
机缘摆在眼前，可危险也如影随形。

他如今寄身林家，依靠韩东庇护才有安稳修行之地。古卷太过不凡，一旦暴露，轻则被人强行夺走，重则引来杀身之祸。
往后修行，依旧低调再低调。明面上继续用《青元引气诀》做掩护，暗中修习古卷之事，除了他和小雪，绝不让第三人知晓。同时控制修行节奏，哪怕古卷进展极快，也刻意压下境界提升的速度，避免锋芒太露，惹人怀疑。
陈默走到小雪身边，蹲下身轻轻抚摸它的绒毛。小狐狸温顺地依偎过来，仿佛懂得他心中的顾虑。
“往后，我们都小心一些。”陈默低声说道。
一人一狐，彼此相伴，守着同一个隐秘，在这座林家小院里，踏着一条无人知晓的路，默默修行。

Chapter 9: Teacher Yan is secretly wary after seeing and hearing (page 1)
The days passed slowly while practicing the exercises openly and practicing the ancient scrolls secretly.
Han Dong still taught carefully. In addition to teaching the Dharma, he also often told Chen Mo about the forces around Qingyang City, basic knowledge about the world of immortality, identification of spiritual herbs, and basic knowledge about magic weapons and talismans.
In the afternoon of this day, the master and the apprentice were sitting in a small pavilion in the courtyard chatting.
"There are different ethnic groups in the journey of cultivating immortals. Humans, demons, and even vegetation and spirits all have people who are pursuing immortality." Han Dong held a teacup in his hand and said slowly, "It's just that the laws of heaven and earth favor the human race. Orthodox exercises and inherited methods are most likely only suitable for human cultivation. If the demon tribe wants to practice, most of them can only rely on blood instincts, ancient inheritance, or find specialized demon cultivation methods. If you want to get the top human race books, it is as difficult as climbing to the sky."
When Chen Mo heard this, his heart moved slightly, and he asked: "Master, isn't there a technique that both humans and monsters can practice smoothly?"
Han Dong thought for a while, then shook his head and said: "Very few. The existing universal entry-level techniques in the world can only barely allow low-level monsters to draw their energy. The operation is extremely lossy and the progress is slow. As for the techniques that can truly allow fellow practitioners from all races to have no barriers, they only exist in ancient rumors and are now extinct. Those classics are said to have been born when the world first opened, inclusive of all ways, regardless of race and blood. However, as time goes by, they have long been submerged in the dust of history."
At this point, he glanced at Chen Mo and lightly warned: "You don't have to aim too high when you first enter the immortal world. Keep the "Qing Yuan Qi Entrainment Technique" in your hands and steadily consolidate the foundation of Qi refining, which is the right way. Just listen to the strange rumors, and don't be greedy."
"Disciple, please remember Master's teachings." Chen Mo bowed and responded.
The conversation aggravated the doubts in his heart again.
Even Han Dong, a well-informed and well-informed descendant of Han Li, bluntly stated that the skills of fellow practitioners from all races were extinct in ancient times. Looking back at the ancient animal skin scroll in his hand, not only is the cultivation of humans and foxes unimpeded, but the spiritual energy circulates smoothly with minimal loss, and the speed of cultivation is even faster than the introductory classics of the time.
The origin of this ancient scroll may be more terrifying than he expected.
He subconsciously glanced at the courtyard. Xiaoxue was walking leisurely by the flower garden. Her fur was shiny and her figure was agile. She no longer looked as frail and sickly as before. The little guy seemed to notice his gaze, looked up, and called out softly.
Practicing together these days, Xiaoxue's progress is still as fast as ever. For the same length of practice, the energy accumulated in its body was always more than twice that of Chen Mo. If this momentum continues, it won't be long before this ordinary wild fox will break through the realm first.
"By the way, you're a very well-behaved fox." Han Dong followed his gaze and smiled casually, "Normally, wild foxes are either restless or wild when they are contaminated with spiritual energy, but it is still docile, which is rare."
"It has been with me since it was a child and has always had a quiet temper." Chen Mo covered it up calmly.
He didn't dare to let his master see anything unusual. Once Han Dong discovers that Xiaoxue is also practicing, and the progress is extremely rapid, he will definitely investigate the reason, and the secret of the animal skin scroll can no longer be hidden.
Opportunities are in front of us, but dangers also follow us.
He now lives in the Lin family and relies on Han Dong's protection to have a stable place to practice. The ancient scroll is so extraordinary that once it is exposed, it may be forcibly taken away, or it may lead to death.
In the future, I will continue to practice in a low-key manner. On the surface, he continued to use the "Qingyuan Qi Entraining Technique" as a cover, and secretly practiced the ancient scrolls. Apart from him and Xiaoxue, he would not let any third party know. At the same time, the pace of practice was controlled. Even if the ancient scrolls progressed very quickly, the speed of improvement was deliberately suppressed to avoid being too sharp and causing trouble.People doubt.
Chen Mo walked to Xiaoxue, squatted down and gently stroked its down. The little fox snuggled up to him docilely, as if he understood his concerns.
"Let's all be more careful from now on," Chen Mo said in a low voice.
One person and one fox, accompanying each other, guarding the same secret, practicing silently on an unknown road in the Lin family courtyard.
